name: Waters
description: Waters makes liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry instruments that separate and identify molecules, plus the columns, chemistry consumables, software and service contracts that run on them; customers are pharmaceutical, clinical, food, environmental and academic labs. Recurring revenue (consumables plus service) is the steady core. On 2026-02-09 it completed a Reverse Morris Trust deal for Becton Dickinson's Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions businesses (total price including assumed debt $16.8 billion), which more than changes the company: flow cytometry research tools and infectious-disease, women's health and cancer-screening diagnostics now make up about half of sales, and BD shareholders own about 39% of Waters. Because of the deal, FY2025 figures (sales $3,165 million, legacy Waters and TA Instruments only) are not comparable with 2026.

employees.note: Before the February 2026 BD Biosciences & Diagnostic Solutions deal; 39% in the United States. Post-deal headcount not read.

businessLines.name: Analytical & Materials Sciences
businessLines.how: Sells LC and mass-spec instruments one-time, then recurring columns and chemistry consumables and service contracts on the installed base; the thermal analysis, rheometry and calorimetry instruments of TA Instruments are in the same segment.

operatingProfit.period: H1 2026 (six months ended 2026-07-04) segment operating profit

businessLines.name: Advanced Diagnostics
businessLines.how: Sells microbiology, molecular diagnostics and near-patient testing instruments to hospitals, clinical labs and public health agencies, then the assays and consumables run on them; also specimen collection products and the Waters Clinical business.

operatingProfit.period: H1 2026 (six months ended 2026-07-04) segment operating profit

businessLines.name: Biosciences
businessLines.how: Sells flow cytometry instruments, reagents, software and single-cell multiomics tools to academic, pharma and biotech labs and clinical labs; instrument sale then repeat reagent purchases.

operatingProfit.period: H1 2026 (six months ended 2026-07-04) segment operating profit

H1 2026 segment revenue: Biosciences $600M and Advanced Diagnostics $870M (the latter includes the legacy Waters Clinical business, $115M in H1 2025).
